'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[War in Amhara]]
**[[2023 Fano–ENDF clashes]]
***The [[Government of Ethiopia|Ethiopian government]] declares a [[2023 Ethiopian state of emergency|state of emergency]] in response to heavy clashes between the [[Ethiopian National Defense Forces|ENDF]] and [[Fano (militia)|Fano militia]] in [[Amhara Region]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/8/4/ethiopia-declares-state-of-emergency-following-clashes-in-amhara (Al Jazeera)]
***The [[Sudan]]ese state of [[Gedaref (state)|El Gedaref]] closes [[Ethiopia–Sudan border|its border]] with [[Ethiopia]] in response to the clashes. [https://sudantribune.net/article275734/ (Sudan Tribune)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[2022–2023 western Russia attacks]]
***The Russian ''[[Russian landing ship Olenegorsky Gornyak|Olenegorsky Gornyak]]'' landing ship is damaged by a [[Ukrainian naval]] [[drone attack]] at the [[naval base]] at the [[Port of Novorossiysk]], [[Krasnodar Krai]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-66402046.amp (BBC News)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Kordofan campaign (2023–present)|Kordofan campaign]]
***Authorities in the [[Sudanese state]] of [[North Kordofan]] announce a state-wide [[curfew]]. [https://www.dabangasudan.org/en/all-news/article/sudan-war-dusk-to-dawn-curfew-in-north-kordofan (Dabanga Sudan)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Israeli settlement|Israeli settlers]] storm the [[State of Palestine|Palestinian]] village of [[Burqa, Ramallah]], killing a 19-year-old man, hours after [[Israeli Defense Forces|Israeli soldiers]] killed another teenager in [[Tulkarm]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/8/4/palestinian-teen-killed-by-israeli-army-in-occupied-west-bank (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Carinthia and Slovenia floods]]
**Three people are killed in [[flash flood]]s in [[Slovenia]]. [https://www.rtvslo.si/okolje/hude-posledice-besnenja-narave-do-zdaj-potrjene-tri-smrtne-zrtve/677033 (RTV Slovenija)]
*Eight people are killed and four others are injured when a [[freight train]] [[train wreck|collides]] with a [[pickup truck]] at a [[level crossing]] in [[Mueang Chachoengsao district]], [[Thailand]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/8/4/train-collides-with-pick-up-truck-in-thailand-kills-eight (Al Jazeera)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Cyprus]] approves the use of [[Treatment and management of COVID-19|human COVID-19 medication]] [[molnupiravir]] to combat a local [[Feline coronavirus|feline virus]] mutation causing [[feline infectious peritonitis]] resulting in numerous cat deaths locally. The [[Government of Cyprus|government]] assures that there is no risk of depleting medication stocks for potential [[COVID-19 pandemic in Cyprus|COVID-19 surges]] in the human population. [https://apnews.com/article/cyprus-covid19-cats-virus-peritonitis-mutation-16484f95aace4ef91c8678094419db77 (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Disqualification of Rahul Gandhi]]
**The [[Supreme Court of India]] suspends [[Indian National Congress]] leader [[Rahul Gandhi]]'s [[defamation]] [[conviction]], potentially allowing his return to [[Parliament of India|parliament]] after disqualification. [https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2023/08/04/india-s-supreme-court-suspends-rahul-gandhi-s-defamation-conviction_6080161_4.html (AFP via ''Le Monde'')]
*[[Kai Cenat Union Square giveaway]]
**[[Civil disorder|Civil unrest]] and [[riot]]ing occur in [[Manhattan]], [[New York City]], [[United States]], after [[Twitch (service)|Twitch]] streamer and [[YouTuber]] [[Kai Cenat]] announces a [[gift card]] and [[PlayStation 5]] [[video game console]] giveaway in [[Union Square, Manhattan|Union Square]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/newyork/news/large-crowd-gathered-at-union-square-seen-hurling-objects/ (CBS News)]
*A court in [[Melekhovo]], [[Vladimir Oblast]], [[Russia]], [[sentence (law)|sentences]] [[Opposition to Vladimir Putin in Russia|opposition]] politician [[Alexei Navalny]] to nineteen years in prison for six crimes, including inciting and financing extremist activity and creating an extremist organization. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/putin-foe-navalny-expects-be-jailed-many-more-years-2023-08-04/ (Reuters)]
*[[Nicolás Petro]] is released from detention while under investigation for allegations of [[illicit enrichment]] and [[money laundering]] connected to [[Gustavo Petro 2022 presidential campaign|his father's 2022 presidential campaign]]. He is barred from engaging in [[Politics of Colombia|political activities]] and from leaving [[Colombia]]. [https://apnews.com/article/colombia-president-son-investigation-06b4a79826e6e7c2e968d91aaa77605e (AP)]
